notes: The OG Widget keeps its size and its corner when you send it to another monitor. It was arriving wider and shorter, sitting slightly off the top and hanging past the right edge of the screen it moved to.

The move itself was never at fault — it places the widget flush in the corner correctly. The damage came from the settings save that follows a moment later: two minimum-size rules, 240 and 320 pixels, both written back when every panel…

A minimum size is the right rule for a panel you size yourself and the wrong one for a panel that sizes itself, so widgets are now exempt rather than the minimum being lowered for everything. Saving any setting can no longer change a…
Sizes already scrambled by this are corrected automatically the first time this version runs.
